finding: Client has no tutorial code. First-30-minute content (intro, tips, first fight, loot, hub) is server-sent and not in the donor. Useful client patterns: per-target damage-number queue (owner hue, 1.5 s life, cap 10), one-overlay death beat with fixed music, preselected creation defaults (default city index 0). Licence BSD-2 (code adaptable with notice); no assets in repo.

Level 1 is a per-player progress ladder (state value steps 0 to 7) where each step fires on a counted action (treasury, lair, garden, creature count, first-wave win), with short timer pauses inside a step. One goal on screen, control flashes until clicked, first fight capped to level-1 enemies that do not flee when wounded, named rival line after the first win. Drop-off risk: gate needs the full creature cap. Licence GPL v2; clean-room shape only. Half read: data (scripts and string template) plus engine checks.
